issues.title: Missing GWT Acceptance Criteria for Core Logic
issues.why: While the spec has boilerplate ACs for file existence and naming (AC-01 to AC-08), it lacks GWT (Given-When-Then) criteria for the actual plugin logic like safeExecute, PSR-4 resolution, or Enum metadata behavior.
issues.fix: Add a 97-acceptance-criteria.md file to Phase 1 and 3 with GWT scenarios for error boundaries and trait composition.

issues.title: Unresolved External References
issues.why: The spec frequently references files like 'linter-scripts/check-spec-cross-links.py' and '99-consistency-report.md' which are mentioned in the inventory but their content/logic is not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Include the content of the linter scripts or provide a detailed interface specification for them within the module.

issues.title: Concurrency and Race Conditions Unaddressed
issues.why: The spec defines a Singleton Plugin class and file-based logging but does not address file locking or race conditions during concurrent REST API requests writing to the same log.
issues.fix: Add a section in Phase 4 (Logging) specifying flock() usage or a dedicated concurrency handling strategy for the FileLogger.
